payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the practical applications of measuring performance using MAP at gold-k, particularly in evaluating entity set expansion (ESE) methods in user-generated text.

claims.text: Measuring MAP at gold-k helps evaluate ESE methods in scenarios with diverse and vague entities, which are common in user-generated text.
The MAP at gold-k metric adapts to varying concept sizes and provides a better estimate of recall, crucial for assessing effectiveness in real-world applications.
Existing benchmarks may not adequately reflect real-world performance, and MAP at gold-k addresses these limitations by focusing on comprehensive evaluations.
